    headers: &HeaderMap,

    path: &str,
    surface: Surface,
) -> Response {
    forward_subscription_openai_inner(
        state,
        headers,
        body,
        routing_body,

            path,
            surface,
            response_shape: SubscriptionResponseShape::Passthrough,
            validated: None,
            entitlement: None,

        },
        None,
